versos.hebraico: וַיְדַבֵּ֨ר יְהוָ֧ה אֶל־מֹשֶׁ֛ה בְּמִדְבַּ֥ר סִינַ֖י בְּאֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֑ד בְּאֶחָד֩ לַחֹ֨דֶשׁ הַשֵּׁנִ֜י בַּשָּׁנָ֣ה הַשֵּׁנִ֗ית לְצֵאתָ֛ם מֵאֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרַ֖יִם לֵאמֹֽר׃

controles.web: Yahweh spoke to Moses in the wilderness of Sinai, in the Tent of Meeting, on the first day of the second month, in the second year after they had come out of the land of Egypt, saying,
controles.kjv: And the Lord spake unto Moses in the wilderness of Sinai, in the tabernacle of the congregation, on the first day of the second month, in the second year after they were come out of the land of Egypt, saying,
controles.livre: E falou o SENHOR a Moisés no deserto de Sinai, no tabernáculo do testemunho, no primeiro dia do mês segundo, no segundo ano de sua saída da terra do Egito, dizendo:

versos.hebraico: שְׂא֗וּ אֶת־רֹאשׁ֙ כָּל־עֲדַ֣ת בְּנֵֽי־יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָ֖ם לְבֵ֣ית אֲבֹתָ֑ם בְּמִסְפַּ֣ר שֵׁמ֔וֹת כָּל־זָכָ֖ר לְגֻלְגְּלֹתָֽם׃

controles.web: “Take a census of all the congregation of the children of Israel, by their families, by their fathers’ houses, according to the number of the names, every male, one by one;
controles.kjv: Take ye the sum of all the congregation of the children of Israel, after their families, by the house of their fathers, with the number of their names, every male by their polls;
controles.livre: Tomai o censo de toda a congregação dos filhos de Israel por suas famílias, pelas casas de seus pais, com a conta dos nomes, todos os homens por suas cabeças:

versos.hebraico: מִבֶּ֨ן עֶשְׂרִ֤ים שָׁנָה֙ וָמַ֔עְלָה כָּל־יֹצֵ֥א צָבָ֖א בְּיִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל תִּפְקְד֥וּ אֹתָ֛ם לְצִבְאֹתָ֖ם אַתָּ֥ה וְאַהֲרֹֽן׃

controles.web: from twenty years old and upward, all who are able to go out to war in Israel. You and Aaron shall number them by their divisions.
controles.kjv: From twenty years old and upward, all that are able to go forth to war in Israel: thou and Aaron shall number them by their armies.
controles.livre: De vinte anos acima, todos os que podem sair à guerra em Israel, os contareis tu e Arão por suas tropas.

versos.hebraico: וְאִתְּכֶ֣ם יִהְי֔וּ אִ֥ישׁ אִ֖ישׁ לַמַּטֶּ֑ה אִ֛ישׁ רֹ֥אשׁ לְבֵית־אֲבֹתָ֖יו הֽוּא׃

controles.web: With you there shall be a man of every tribe; everyone head of his fathers’ house.
controles.kjv: And with you there shall be a man of every tribe; every one head of the house of his fathers.
controles.livre: E estará convosco um homem de cada tribo, cada um chefe da casa de seus pais.

versos.hebraico: וְאֵ֨לֶּה֙ שְׁמ֣וֹת הָֽאֲנָשִׁ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר יַֽעַמְד֖וּ אִתְּכֶ֑ם לִרְאוּבֵ֕ן אֱלִיצ֖וּר בֶּן־שְׁדֵיאֽוּר׃

controles.web: These are the names of the men who shall stand with you:   Of Reuben: Elizur the son of Shedeur.
controles.kjv: And these are the names of the men that shall stand with you: of the tribe of Reuben; Elizur the son of Shedeur.
controles.livre: E estes são os nomes dos homens que estarão convosco: Da tribo de Rúben, Elizur filho de Sedeur.

versos.hebraico: לְשִׁמְע֕וֹן שְׁלֻמִיאֵ֖ל בֶּן־צוּרִֽישַׁדָּֽי׃

controles.web: Of Simeon: Shelumiel the son of Zurishaddai.
controles.kjv: Of Simeon; Shelumiel the son of Zurishaddai.
controles.livre: De Simeão, Selumiel filho de Zurisadai.

versos.hebraico: לִֽיהוּדָ֕ה נַחְשׁ֖וֹן בֶּן־עַמִּינָדָֽב׃

controles.web: Of Judah: Nahshon the son of Amminadab.
controles.kjv: Of Judah; Nahshon the son of Amminadab.
controles.livre: De Judá, Naassom filho de Aminadabe.

versos.hebraico: לְיִ֨שָּׂשכָ֔ר נְתַנְאֵ֖ל בֶּן־צוּעָֽר׃

controles.web: Of Issachar: Nethanel the son of Zuar.
controles.kjv: Of Issachar; Nethaneel the son of Zuar.
controles.livre: De Issacar, Natanael filho de Zuar.

versos.hebraico: לִזְבוּלֻ֕ן אֱלִיאָ֖ב בֶּן־חֵלֹֽן׃

controles.web: Of Zebulun: Eliab the son of Helon.
controles.kjv: Of Zebulun; Eliab the son of Helon.
controles.livre: De Zebulom, Eliabe filho de Helom.

versos.hebraico: לִבְנֵ֣י יוֹסֵ֔ף לְאֶפְרַ֕יִם אֱלִישָׁמָ֖ע בֶּן־עַמִּיה֑וּד לִמְנַשֶּׁ֕ה גַּמְלִיאֵ֖ל בֶּן־פְּדָהצֽוּר׃

controles.web: Of the children of Joseph:   Of Ephraim: Elishama the son of Ammihud.   Of Manasseh: Gamaliel the son of Pedahzur.
controles.kjv: Of the children of Joseph: of Ephraim; Elishama the son of Ammihud: of Manasseh; Gamaliel the son of Pedahzur.
controles.livre: Dos filhos de José: de Efraim, Elisama filho de Amiúde; de Manassés, Gamaliel filho de Pedazur.

versos.hebraico: לְבִ֨נְיָמִ֔ן אֲבִידָ֖ן בֶּן־גִּדְעֹנִֽי׃

controles.web: Of Benjamin: Abidan the son of Gideoni.
controles.kjv: Of Benjamin; Abidan the son of Gideoni.
controles.livre: De Benjamim, Abidã filho de Gideoni.

versos.hebraico: לְדָ֕ן אֲחִיעֶ֖זֶר בֶּן־עַמִּֽישַׁדָּֽי׃

controles.web: Of Dan: Ahiezer the son of Ammishaddai.
controles.kjv: Of Dan; Ahiezer the son of Ammishaddai.
controles.livre: De Dã, Aiezer filho de Amisadai.

versos.hebraico: לְאָשֵׁ֕ר פַּגְעִיאֵ֖ל בֶּן־עָכְרָֽן׃

controles.web: Of Asher: Pagiel the son of Ochran.
controles.kjv: Of Asher; Pagiel the son of Ocran.
controles.livre: De Aser, Pagiel filho de Ocrã.

versos.hebraico: לְגָ֕ד אֶלְיָסָ֖ף בֶּן־דְּעוּאֵֽל׃

controles.web: Of Gad: Eliasaph the son of Deuel.
controles.kjv: Of Gad; Eliasaph the son of Deuel.
controles.livre: De Gade, Eliasafe filho de Deuel.

versos.hebraico: לְנַ֨פְתָּלִ֔י אֲחִירַ֖ע בֶּן־עֵינָֽן׃

controles.web: Of Naphtali: Ahira the son of Enan.”
controles.kjv: Of Naphtali; Ahira the son of Enan.
controles.livre: De Naftali, Aira filho de Enã.

versos.hebraico: אֵ֚לֶּה קריאי הָעֵדָ֔ה נְשִׂיאֵ֖י מַטּ֣וֹת אֲבוֹתָ֑ם רָאשֵׁ֛י אַלְפֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל הֵֽם׃

controles.web: These are those who were called of the congregation, the princes of the tribes of their fathers; they were the heads of the thousands of Israel.
controles.kjv: These were the renowned of the congregation, princes of the tribes of their fathers, heads of thousands in Israel.
controles.livre: Estes foram os nomeados da congregação, príncipes das tribos de seus pais, capitães dos milhares de Israel.

versos.hebraico: וַיִּקַּ֥ח מֹשֶׁ֖ה וְאַהֲרֹ֑ן אֵ֚ת הָאֲנָשִׁ֣ים הָאֵ֔לֶּה אֲשֶׁ֥ר נִקְּב֖וּ בְּשֵׁמֽוֹת׃

controles.web: Moses and Aaron took these men who are mentioned by name.
controles.kjv: And Moses and Aaron took these men which are expressed by their names:
controles.livre: Tomou pois Moisés e Arão a estes homens que foram declarados por seus nomes:

versos.hebraico: וְאֵ֨ת כָּל־הָעֵדָ֜ה הִקְהִ֗ילוּ בְּאֶחָד֙ לַחֹ֣דֶשׁ הַשֵּׁנִ֔י וַיִּתְיַֽלְד֥וּ עַל־מִשְׁפְּחֹתָ֖ם לְבֵ֣ית אֲבֹתָ֑ם בְּמִסְפַּ֣ר שֵׁמ֗וֹת מִבֶּ֨ן עֶשְׂרִ֥ים שָׁנָ֛ה וָמַ֖עְלָה לְגֻלְגְּלֹתָֽם׃

controles.web: They assembled all the congregation together on the first day of the second month; and they declared their ancestry by their families, by their fathers’ houses, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, one by one.
controles.kjv: And they assembled all the congregation together on the first day of the second month, and they declared their pedigrees after their families, by the house of their fathers, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, by their polls.
controles.livre: E juntaram toda a congregação no primeiro dia do mês segundo, e foram reunidos suas linhagens, pelas casas de seus pais, segundo a conta dos nomes, de vinte anos acima, por suas cabeças,

versos.hebraico: כַּאֲשֶׁ֛ר צִוָּ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה אֶת־מֹשֶׁ֑ה וַֽיִּפְקְדֵ֖ם בְּמִדְבַּ֥ר סִינָֽי׃פ

controles.web: As Yahweh commanded Moses, so he numbered them in the wilderness of Sinai.
controles.kjv: As the Lord commanded Moses, so he numbered them in the wilderness of Sinai.
controles.livre: Como o SENHOR o havia mandado a Moisés; e contou-os no deserto de Sinai.

versos.hebraico: וַיִּהְי֤וּ בְנֵֽי־רְאוּבֵן֙ בְּכֹ֣ר יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל תּוֹלְדֹתָ֥ם לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָ֖ם לְבֵ֣ית אֲבֹתָ֑ם בְּמִסְפַּ֤ר שֵׁמוֹת֙ לְגֻלְגְּלֹתָ֔ם כָּל־זָכָ֗ר מִבֶּ֨ן עֶשְׂרִ֤ים שָׁנָה֙ וָמַ֔עְלָה כֹּ֖ל יֹצֵ֥א צָבָֽא׃

controles.web: The children of Reuben, Israel’s firstborn, their generations, by their families, by their fathers’ houses, according to the number of the names, one by one, every male from twenty years old and upward, all who were able to go out to war;
controles.kjv: And the children of Reuben, Israel’s eldest son, by their generations, after their families, by the house of their fathers, according to the number of the names, by their polls, every male from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war;
controles.livre: E os filhos de Rúben, primogênito de Israel, por suas gerações, por suas famílias, pelas casas de seus pais, conforme a conta dos nomes por suas cabeças, todos os homens de vinte anos acima, todos os que podiam sair à guerra;

versos.hebraico: פְּקֻדֵיהֶ֖ם לְמַטֵּ֣ה רְאוּבֵ֑ן שִׁשָּׁ֧ה וְאַרְבָּעִ֛ים אֶ֖לֶף וַחֲמֵ֥שׁ מֵאֽוֹת׃פ

controles.web: those who were numbered of them, of the tribe of Reuben, were forty-six thousand five hundred.
controles.kjv: Those that were numbered of them, even of the tribe of Reuben, were forty and six thousand and five hundred.
controles.livre: Os contados deles, da tribo de Rúben, foram quarenta e seis mil e quinhentos.

versos.hebraico: לִבְנֵ֣י שִׁמְע֔וֹן תּוֹלְדֹתָ֥ם לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָ֖ם לְבֵ֣ית אֲבֹתָ֑ם פְּקֻדָ֗יו בְּמִסְפַּ֤ר שֵׁמוֹת֙ לְגֻלְגְּלֹתָ֔ם כָּל־זָכָ֗ר מִבֶּ֨ן עֶשְׂרִ֤ים שָׁנָה֙ וָמַ֔עְלָה כֹּ֖ל יֹצֵ֥א צָבָֽא׃

controles.web: Of the children of Simeon, their generations, by their families, by their fathers’ houses, those who were numbered of it, according to the number of the names, one by one, every male from twenty years old and upward, all who were able to go out to war;
controles.kjv: Of the children of Simeon, by their generations, after their families, by the house of their fathers, those that were numbered of them, according to the number of the names, by their polls, every male from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war;
controles.livre: Dos filhos de Simeão, por suas gerações, por suas famílias, pelas casas de seus pais, os contados deles conforme a conta dos nomes por suas cabeças, todos os homens de vinte anos acima, todos os que podiam sair à guerra;

versos.hebraico: פְּקֻדֵיהֶ֖ם לְמַטֵּ֣ה שִׁמְע֑וֹן תִּשְׁעָ֧ה וַחֲמִשִּׁ֛ים אֶ֖לֶף וּשְׁלֹ֥שׁ מֵאֽוֹת׃פ

controles.web: those who were numbered of them, of the tribe of Simeon, were fifty-nine thousand three hundred.
controles.kjv: Those that were numbered of them, even of the tribe of Simeon, were fifty and nine thousand and three hundred.
controles.livre: Os contados deles, da tribo de Simeão, cinquenta e nove mil e trezentos.

versos.hebraico: לִבְנֵ֣י גָ֔ד תּוֹלְדֹתָ֥ם לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָ֖ם לְבֵ֣ית אֲבֹתָ֑ם בְּמִסְפַּ֣ר שֵׁמ֗וֹת מִבֶּ֨ן עֶשְׂרִ֤ים שָׁנָה֙ וָמַ֔עְלָה כֹּ֖ל יֹצֵ֥א צָבָֽא׃

controles.web: Of the children of Gad, their generations, by their families, by their fathers’ houses, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all who were able to go out to war;
controles.kjv: Of the children of Gad, by their generations, after their families, by the house of their fathers, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war;
controles.livre: Dos filhos de Gade, por suas gerações, por suas famílias, pelas casas de seus pais, conforme a conta dos nomes, de vinte anos acima, todos os que podiam sair à guerra;

versos.hebraico: פְּקֻדֵיהֶ֖ם לְמַטֵּ֣ה גָ֑ד חֲמִשָּׁ֤ה וְאַרְבָּעִים֙ אֶ֔לֶף וְשֵׁ֥שׁ מֵא֖וֹת וַחֲמִשִּֽׁים׃פ

controles.web: those who were numbered of them, of the tribe of Gad, were forty-five thousand six hundred fifty.
controles.kjv: Those that were numbered of them, even of the tribe of Gad, were forty and five thousand six hundred and fifty.
controles.livre: Os contados deles, da tribo de Gade, quarenta e cinco mil seiscentos e cinquenta.

versos.hebraico: לִבְנֵ֣י יְהוּדָ֔ה תּוֹלְדֹתָ֥ם לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָ֖ם לְבֵ֣ית אֲבֹתָ֑ם בְּמִסְפַּ֣ר שֵׁמֹ֗ת מִבֶּ֨ן עֶשְׂרִ֤ים שָׁנָה֙ וָמַ֔עְלָה כֹּ֖ל יֹצֵ֥א צָבָֽא׃

controles.web: Of the children of Judah, their generations, by their families, by their fathers’ houses, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all who were able to go out to war;
controles.kjv: Of the children of Judah, by their generations, after their families, by the house of their fathers, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war;
controles.livre: Dos filhos de Judá, por suas gerações, por suas famílias, pelas casas de seus pais, conforme a conta dos nomes, de vinte anos acima, todos os que podiam sair à guerra;

versos.hebraico: פְּקֻדֵיהֶ֖ם לְמַטֵּ֣ה יְהוּדָ֑ה אַרְבָּעָ֧ה וְשִׁבְעִ֛ים אֶ֖לֶף וְשֵׁ֥שׁ מֵאֽוֹת׃פ

controles.web: those who were numbered of them, of the tribe of Judah, were seventy-four thousand six hundred.
controles.kjv: Those that were numbered of them, even of the tribe of Judah, were threescore and fourteen thousand and six hundred.
controles.livre: Os contados deles, da tribo de Judá, setenta e quatro mil e seiscentos.

versos.hebraico: לִבְנֵ֣י יִשָּׂשכָ֔ר תּוֹלְדֹתָ֥ם לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָ֖ם לְבֵ֣ית אֲבֹתָ֑ם בְּמִסְפַּ֣ר שֵׁמֹ֗ת מִבֶּ֨ן עֶשְׂרִ֤ים שָׁנָה֙ וָמַ֔עְלָה כֹּ֖ל יֹצֵ֥א צָבָֽא׃

controles.web: Of the children of Issachar, their generations, by their families, by their fathers’ houses, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all who were able to go out to war;
controles.kjv: Of the children of Issachar, by their generations, after their families, by the house of their fathers, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war;
controles.livre: Dos filhos de Issacar, por suas gerações, por suas famílias, pelas casas de seus pais, conforme a conta dos nomes, de vinte anos acima, todos os que podiam sair à guerra;

versos.hebraico: פְּקֻדֵיהֶ֖ם לְמַטֵּ֣ה יִשָּׂשכָ֑ר אַרְבָּעָ֧ה וַחֲמִשִּׁ֛ים אֶ֖לֶף וְאַרְבַּ֥ע מֵאֽוֹת׃פ

controles.web: those who were numbered of them, of the tribe of Issachar, were fifty-four thousand four hundred.
controles.kjv: Those that were numbered of them, even of the tribe of Issachar, were fifty and four thousand and four hundred.
controles.livre: Os contados deles, da tribo de Issacar, cinquenta e quatro mil e quatrocentos.

versos.hebraico: לִבְנֵ֣י זְבוּלֻ֔ן תּוֹלְדֹתָ֥ם לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָ֖ם לְבֵ֣ית אֲבֹתָ֑ם בְּמִסְפַּ֣ר שֵׁמֹ֗ת מִבֶּ֨ן עֶשְׂרִ֤ים שָׁנָה֙ וָמַ֔עְלָה כֹּ֖ל יֹצֵ֥א צָבָֽא׃

controles.web: Of the children of Zebulun, their generations, by their families, by their fathers’ houses, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all who were able to go out to war;
controles.kjv: Of the children of Zebulun, by their generations, after their families, by the house of their fathers, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war;
controles.livre: Dos filhos de Zebulom, por suas gerações, por suas famílias, pelas casas de seus pais, conforme a conta de seus nomes, de vinte anos acima, todos os que podiam sair à guerra;

versos.hebraico: פְּקֻדֵיהֶ֖ם לְמַטֵּ֣ה זְבוּלֻ֑ן שִׁבְעָ֧ה וַחֲמִשִּׁ֛ים אֶ֖לֶף וְאַרְבַּ֥ע מֵאֽוֹת׃פ

controles.web: those who were numbered of them, of the tribe of Zebulun, were fifty-seven thousand four hundred.
controles.kjv: Those that were numbered of them, even of the tribe of Zebulun, were fifty and seven thousand and four hundred.
controles.livre: Os contados deles, da tribo de Zebulom, cinquenta e sete mil e quatrocentos.

versos.hebraico: לִבְנֵ֤י יוֹסֵף֙ לִבְנֵ֣י אֶפְרַ֔יִם תּוֹלְדֹתָ֥ם לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָ֖ם לְבֵ֣ית אֲבֹתָ֑ם בְּמִסְפַּ֣ר שֵׁמֹ֗ת מִבֶּ֨ן עֶשְׂרִ֤ים שָׁנָה֙ וָמַ֔עְלָה כֹּ֖ל יֹצֵ֥א צָבָֽא׃

controles.web: Of the children of Joseph, of the children of Ephraim, their generations, by their families, by their fathers’ houses, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all who were able to go out to war;
controles.kjv: Of the children of Joseph, namely, of the children of Ephraim, by their generations, after their families, by the house of their fathers, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war;
controles.livre: Dos filhos de José: dos filhos de Efraim, por suas gerações, por suas famílias, pelas casas de seus pais, conforme a conta dos nomes, de vinte anos acima, todos os que podiam sair à guerra;

versos.hebraico: פְּקֻדֵיהֶ֖ם לְמַטֵּ֣ה אֶפְרָ֑יִם אַרְבָּעִ֥ים אֶ֖לֶף וַחֲמֵ֥שׁ מֵאֽוֹת׃פ

controles.web: those who were numbered of them, of the tribe of Ephraim, were forty thousand five hundred.
controles.kjv: Those that were numbered of them, even of the tribe of Ephraim, were forty thousand and five hundred.
controles.livre: Os contados deles, da tribo de Efraim, quarenta mil e quinhentos.

versos.hebraico: לִבְנֵ֣י מְנַשֶּׁ֔ה תּוֹלְדֹתָ֥ם לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָ֖ם לְבֵ֣ית אֲבֹתָ֑ם בְּמִסְפַּ֣ר שֵׁמ֗וֹת מִבֶּ֨ן עֶשְׂרִ֤ים שָׁנָה֙ וָמַ֔עְלָה כֹּ֖ל יֹצֵ֥א צָבָֽא׃

controles.web: Of the children of Manasseh, their generations, by their families, by their fathers’ houses, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all who were able to go out to war;
controles.kjv: Of the children of Manasseh, by their generations, after their families, by the house of their fathers, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war;
controles.livre: Dos filhos de Manassés, por suas gerações, por suas famílias, pelas casas de seus pais, conforme a conta dos nomes, de vinte anos acima, todos os que podiam sair à guerra;

versos.hebraico: פְּקֻדֵיהֶ֖ם לְמַטֵּ֣ה מְנַשֶּׁ֑ה שְׁנַ֧יִם וּשְׁלֹשִׁ֛ים אֶ֖לֶף וּמָאתָֽיִם׃פ

controles.web: those who were numbered of them, of the tribe of Manasseh, were thirty-two thousand two hundred.
controles.kjv: Those that were numbered of them, even of the tribe of Manasseh, were thirty and two thousand and two hundred.
controles.livre: Os contados deles, da tribo de Manassés, trinta e dois mil e duzentos.

versos.hebraico: לִבְנֵ֣י בִנְיָמִ֔ן תּוֹלְדֹתָ֥ם לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָ֖ם לְבֵ֣ית אֲבֹתָ֑ם בְּמִסְפַּ֣ר שֵׁמֹ֗ת מִבֶּ֨ן עֶשְׂרִ֤ים שָׁנָה֙ וָמַ֔עְלָה כֹּ֖ל יֹצֵ֥א צָבָֽא׃

controles.web: Of the children of Benjamin, their generations, by their families, by their fathers’ houses, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all who were able to go out to war;
controles.kjv: Of the children of Benjamin, by their generations, after their families, by the house of their fathers, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war;
controles.livre: Dos filhos de Benjamim, por suas gerações, por suas famílias, pelas casas de seus pais, conforme a conta dos nomes, de vinte anos acima, todos os que podiam sair à guerra;

versos.hebraico: פְּקֻדֵיהֶ֖ם לְמַטֵּ֣ה בִנְיָמִ֑ן חֲמִשָּׁ֧ה וּשְׁלֹשִׁ֛ים אֶ֖לֶף וְאַרְבַּ֥ע מֵאֽוֹת׃פ

controles.web: those who were numbered of them, of the tribe of Benjamin, were thirty-five thousand four hundred.
controles.kjv: Those that were numbered of them, even of the tribe of Benjamin, were thirty and five thousand and four hundred.
controles.livre: Os contados deles, da tribo de Benjamim, trinta e cinco mil e quatrocentos.

versos.hebraico: לִבְנֵ֣י דָ֔ן תּוֹלְדֹתָ֥ם לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָ֖ם לְבֵ֣ית אֲבֹתָ֑ם בְּמִסְפַּ֣ר שֵׁמֹ֗ת מִבֶּ֨ן עֶשְׂרִ֤ים שָׁנָה֙ וָמַ֔עְלָה כֹּ֖ל יֹצֵ֥א צָבָֽא׃

controles.web: Of the children of Dan, their generations, by their families, by their fathers’ houses, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all who were able to go out to war;
controles.kjv: Of the children of Dan, by their generations, after their families, by the house of their fathers, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war;
controles.livre: Dos filhos de Dã, por suas gerações, por suas famílias, pelas casas de seus pais, conforme a conta dos nomes, de vinte anos acima, todos os que podiam sair à guerra;

versos.hebraico: פְּקֻדֵיהֶ֖ם לְמַטֵּ֣ה דָ֑ן שְׁנַ֧יִם וְשִׁשִּׁ֛ים אֶ֖לֶף וּשְׁבַ֥ע מֵאֽוֹת׃פ

controles.web: those who were numbered of them, of the tribe of Dan, were sixty-two thousand seven hundred.
controles.kjv: Those that were numbered of them, even of the tribe of Dan, were threescore and two thousand and seven hundred.
controles.livre: Os contados deles, da tribo de Dã, sessenta e dois mil e setecentos.

versos.hebraico: לִבְנֵ֣י אָשֵׁ֔ר תּוֹלְדֹתָ֥ם לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָ֖ם לְבֵ֣ית אֲבֹתָ֑ם בְּמִסְפַּ֣ר שֵׁמֹ֗ת מִבֶּ֨ן עֶשְׂרִ֤ים שָׁנָה֙ וָמַ֔עְלָה כֹּ֖ל יֹצֵ֥א צָבָֽא׃

controles.web: Of the children of Asher, their generations, by their families, by their fathers’ houses, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all who were able to go out to war;
controles.kjv: Of the children of Asher, by their generations, after their families, by the house of their fathers, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war;
controles.livre: Dos filhos de Aser, por suas gerações, por suas famílias, pelas casas de seus pais, conforme a conta dos nomes, de vinte anos acima, todos os que podiam sair à guerra.

versos.hebraico: פְּקֻדֵיהֶ֖ם לְמַטֵּ֣ה אָשֵׁ֑ר אֶחָ֧ד וְאַרְבָּעִ֛ים אֶ֖לֶף וַחֲמֵ֥שׁ מֵאֽוֹת׃פ

controles.web: those who were numbered of them, of the tribe of Asher, were forty-one thousand five hundred.
controles.kjv: Those that were numbered of them, even of the tribe of Asher, were forty and one thousand and five hundred.
controles.livre: Os contados deles, da tribo de Aser, quarenta e um mil e quinhentos.

versos.hebraico: בְּנֵ֣י נַפְתָּלִ֔י תּוֹלְדֹתָ֥ם לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָ֖ם לְבֵ֣ית אֲבֹתָ֑ם בְּמִסְפַּ֣ר שֵׁמֹ֗ת מִבֶּ֨ן עֶשְׂרִ֤ים שָׁנָה֙ וָמַ֔עְלָה כֹּ֖ל יֹצֵ֥א צָבָֽא׃

controles.web: Of the children of Naphtali, their generations, by their families, by their fathers’ houses, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all who were able to go out to war;
controles.kjv: Of the children of Naphtali, throughout their generations, after their families, by the house of their fathers, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war;
controles.livre: Dos filhos de Naftali, por suas gerações, por suas famílias, pelas casas de seus pais, conforme a conta dos nomes, de vinte anos acima, todos os que podiam sair à guerra;

versos.hebraico: פְּקֻדֵיהֶ֖ם לְמַטֵּ֣ה נַפְתָּלִ֑י שְׁלֹשָׁ֧ה וַחֲמִשִּׁ֛ים אֶ֖לֶף וְאַרְבַּ֥ע מֵאֽוֹת׃פ

controles.web: those who were numbered of them, of the tribe of Naphtali, were fifty-three thousand four hundred.
controles.kjv: Those that were numbered of them, even of the tribe of Naphtali, were fifty and three thousand and four hundred.
controles.livre: Os contados deles, da tribo de Naftali, cinquenta e três mil e quatrocentos.

versos.hebraico: אֵ֣לֶּה הַפְּקֻדִ֡ים אֲשֶׁר֩ פָּקַ֨ד מֹשֶׁ֤ה וְאַהֲרֹן֙ וּנְשִׂיאֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל שְׁנֵ֥ים עָשָׂ֖ר אִ֑ישׁ אִישׁ־אֶחָ֥ד לְבֵית־אֲבֹתָ֖יו הָיֽוּ׃

controles.web: These are those who were numbered, whom Moses and Aaron numbered, and the princes of Israel, being twelve men: they were each one for his fathers’ house.
controles.kjv: These are those that were numbered, which Moses and Aaron numbered, and the princes of Israel, being twelve men: each one was for the house of his fathers.
controles.livre: Estes foram os contados, os quais contaram Moisés e Arão, com os príncipes de Israel, que eram doze, um por cada casa de seus pais.

versos.hebraico: וַיִּֽהְי֛וּ כָּל־פְּקוּדֵ֥י בְנֵֽי־יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לְבֵ֣ית אֲבֹתָ֑ם מִבֶּ֨ן עֶשְׂרִ֤ים שָׁנָה֙ וָמַ֔עְלָה כָּל־יֹצֵ֥א צָבָ֖א בְּיִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

controles.web: So all those who were numbered of the children of Israel by their fathers’ houses, from twenty years old and upward, all who were able to go out to war in Israel;
controles.kjv: So were all those that were numbered of the children of Israel, by the house of their fathers, from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war in Israel;
controles.livre: E foram todos os contados dos filhos de Israel pelas casas de seus pais, de vinte anos acima, todos os que podiam sair à guerra em Israel;

versos.hebraico: וַיִּֽהְיוּ֙ כָּל־הַפְּקֻדִ֔ים שֵׁשׁ־מֵא֥וֹת אֶ֖לֶף וּשְׁלֹ֣שֶׁת אֲלָפִ֑ים וַחֲמֵ֥שׁ מֵא֖וֹת וַחֲמִשִּֽׁים׃

controles.web: even all those who were numbered were six hundred three thousand five hundred fifty.
controles.kjv: Even all they that were numbered were six hundred thousand and three thousand and five hundred and fifty.
controles.livre: Foram todos os contados seiscentos três mil quinhentos e cinquenta.

versos.hebraico: וְהַלְוִיִּ֖ם לְמַטֵּ֣ה אֲבֹתָ֑ם לֹ֥א הָתְפָּקְד֖וּ בְּתוֹכָֽם׃פ

controles.web: But the Levites after the tribe of their fathers were not numbered among them.
controles.kjv: But the Levites after the tribe of their fathers were not numbered among them.
controles.livre: Porém os levitas não foram contados entre eles segundo a tribo de seus pais.

versos.hebraico: וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אֶל־מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּאמֹֽר׃

controles.web: For Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,
controles.kjv: For the Lord had spoken unto Moses, saying,
controles.livre: Porque falou o SENHOR a Moisés, dizendo:

versos.hebraico: אַ֣ךְ אֶת־מַטֵּ֤ה לֵוִי֙ לֹ֣א תִפְקֹ֔ד וְאֶת־רֹאשָׁ֖ם לֹ֣א תִשָּׂ֑א בְּת֖וֹךְ בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

controles.web: “Only the tribe of Levi you shall not number, neither shall you take a census of them among the children of Israel;
controles.kjv: Only thou shalt not number the tribe of Levi, neither take the sum of them among the children of Israel:
controles.livre: Somente não contarás a tribo de Levi, nem tomarás a conta deles entre os filhos de Israel:

versos.hebraico: וְאַתָּ֡ה הַפְקֵ֣ד אֶת־הַלְוִיִּם֩ עַל־מִשְׁכַּ֨ן הָעֵדֻ֜ת וְעַ֣ל כָּל־כֵּלָיו֮ וְעַ֣ל כָּל־אֲשֶׁר־לוֹ֒ הֵ֜מָּה יִשְׂא֤וּ אֶת־הַמִּשְׁכָּן֙ וְאֶת־כָּל־כֵּלָ֔יו וְהֵ֖ם יְשָׁרְתֻ֑הוּ וְסָבִ֥יב לַמִּשְׁכָּ֖ן יַחֲנֽוּ׃

controles.web: but appoint the Levites over the Tabernacle of the Testimony, and over all its furnishings, and over all that belongs to it. They shall carry the tabernacle, and all its furnishings; and they shall take care of it, and shall encamp around it.
controles.kjv: But thou shalt appoint the Levites over the tabernacle of testimony, and over all the vessels thereof, and over all things that belong to it: they shall bear the tabernacle, and all the vessels thereof; and they shall minister unto it, and shall encamp round about the tabernacle.
controles.livre: Mas tu porás aos levitas no tabernáculo do testemunho, e sobre todos os seus utensílios, e sobre todas as coisas que lhe pertencem: eles levarão o tabernáculo e todos os seus utensílios, e eles servirão nele, e assentarão suas tendas ao redor do tabernáculo.

versos.hebraico: וּבִנְסֹ֣עַ הַמִּשְׁכָּ֗ן יוֹרִ֤ידוּ אֹתוֹ֙ הַלְוִיִּ֔ם וּבַחֲנֹת֙ הַמִּשְׁכָּ֔ן יָקִ֥ימוּ אֹת֖וֹ הַלְוִיִּ֑ם וְהַזָּ֥ר הַקָּרֵ֖ב יוּמָֽת׃

controles.web: When the tabernacle is to move, the Levites shall take it down; and when the tabernacle is to be set up, the Levites shall set it up. The stranger who comes near shall be put to death.
controles.kjv: And when the tabernacle setteth forward, the Levites shall take it down: and when the tabernacle is to be pitched, the Levites shall set it up: and the stranger that cometh nigh shall be put to death.
controles.livre: E quando o tabernáculo partir, os levitas o desarmarão; e quando o tabernáculo parar, os levitas o armarão: e o estranho que se chegar, morrerá.

versos.hebraico: וְחָנ֖וּ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל אִ֧ישׁ עַֽל־מַחֲנֵ֛הוּ וְאִ֥ישׁ עַל־דִּגְל֖וֹ לְצִבְאֹתָֽם׃

controles.web: The children of Israel shall pitch their tents, every man by his own camp, and every man by his own standard, according to their divisions.
controles.kjv: And the children of Israel shall pitch their tents, every man by his own camp, and every man by his own standard, throughout their hosts.
controles.livre: E os filhos de Israel assentarão suas tendas cada um em seu esquadrão, e cada um junto à sua bandeira, por suas tropas;

versos.hebraico: וְהַלְוִיִּ֞ם יַחֲנ֤וּ סָבִיב֙ לְמִשְׁכַּ֣ן הָעֵדֻ֔ת וְלֹֽא־יִהְיֶ֣ה קֶ֔צֶף עַל־עֲדַ֖ת בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וְשָׁמְרוּ֙ הַלְוִיִּ֔ם אֶת־מִשְׁמֶ֖רֶת מִשְׁכַּ֥ן הָעֵדֽוּת׃

controles.web: But the Levites shall encamp around the Tabernacle of the Testimony, that there may be no wrath on the congregation of the children of Israel: and the Levites shall be responsible for the Tabernacle of the Testimony.”
controles.kjv: But the Levites shall pitch round about the tabernacle of testimony, that there be no wrath upon the congregation of the children of Israel: and the Levites shall keep the charge of the tabernacle of testimony.
controles.livre: Mas os levitas assentarão as suas ao redor do tabernáculo do testemunho, e não haverá ira sobre a congregação dos filhos de Israel: e os levitas terão a guarda do tabernáculo do testemunho.

versos.hebraico: וַֽיַּעֲשׂ֖וּ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל כְּ֠כֹל אֲשֶׁ֨ר צִוָּ֧ה יְהוָ֛ה אֶת־מֹשֶׁ֖ה כֵּ֥ן עָשֽׂוּ׃פ

controles.web: Thus the children of Israel did. According to all that Yahweh commanded Moses, so they did.
controles.kjv: And the children of Israel did according to all that the Lord commanded Moses, so did they.
controles.livre: E fizeram os filhos de Israel conforme todas as coisas que mandou o SENHOR a Moisés; assim o fizeram.
